name: addPollRoute
explanation: Reads the new poll from the request body and saves it. It answers 201 with a new poll, 200 with the earlier poll when the same submission was already saved, or 400 with the validation message when the input is not usable.

name: addPollTask
explanation: Loads the poll list and, when a poll with the same submission id already exists, returns that poll as not created. Otherwise it adds the new poll, saves the list, and returns it as created; it runs inside the write queue, so two sends of one form cannot both create a poll.

name: announceListening
explanation: Prints the address the server listens on once the port is open.

name: castVoteTask
explanation: Loads the poll list, records the vote, and saves the list only when the vote counted. It returns the outcome and the updated poll as the voter sees it.

name: closeServer
explanation: Stops accepting new connections, closes open ones, and exits the process with code 0 once the server has closed.

name: createServer
explanation: Creates the HTTP server for the poll app. Every request it receives goes to the request handler, which uses the given data file for storage.

name: ensureVoter
explanation: Returns the voter id from the browser cookie. A browser without a valid cookie gets a new id, and the response sets the cookie.

name: exitAfterClose
explanation: Exits the process with code 0 once the server has finished closing.

name: handleRequest
explanation: Hands each incoming request to serveRequest. The handler does not wait for it, because serveRequest sends the response itself.

name: holdQueue
explanation: Stores the release function for the current task, so the next queued task waits until this one finishes.

name: readCookie
explanation: Finds one named value in a Cookie header and returns it, or null when the cookie is missing.

name: readJsonBody
explanation: Reads the request body, enforces a 10 KB size limit, and parses it as JSON. An empty body counts as an empty object. A body that is too large or not valid JSON becomes an error with a status code.

name: releaseQueue
explanation: Releases the queue after the task finishes, whether it succeeded or failed, so the next queued task can start.

name: routeRequest
explanation: Matches the request method and path to the right handler: the page, the poll list, creating a poll, or voting. The poll list and the vote route receive the browser voter id from its cookie. Unknown routes get a 404.

name: runExclusive
explanation: Runs one data task after the task before it finishes, so two writes never overlap. It returns the result of the task, or its error.

name: runTask
explanation: Runs the queued data task once the task before it has finished.

name: sendJson
explanation: Sends a JSON response with the given status code and a correct content length.

name: sendPolls
explanation: Reads the poll list from the data file and sends it to the browser in the public shape. Only the browser that asks sees its own choice, marked as yourVote.

name: sendStatic
explanation: Sends one file from the public folder with its content type and a no-store cache header.

name: serveRequest
explanation: Routes one request and turns any error into a response. Known errors send their own status code, and anything else becomes a 500 that the server logs.

name: startFromEnvironment
explanation: Reads PORT and DATA_FILE from the environment, starts the server, and stops it cleanly on SIGTERM or SIGINT.

name: stopOnSignal
explanation: Closes the server when the process gets SIGTERM or SIGINT, so the process exits cleanly with code 0.

name: votePollRoute
explanation: Reads the chosen option from the request body and records the vote. It answers 200 with the updated poll, or the matching error status for an unknown poll, a bad option, or a repeat vote.

name: addVotes
explanation: Adds the votes of one option to a running total. It counts all votes in a poll.

name: ballotOf
explanation: Returns the option index that one voter chose in a poll. It returns null when the voter has not voted, and also for an old voter whose choice was never recorded.

name: castVote
explanation: Records one vote for an option in a poll. It refuses an unknown poll, an option that does not exist, and a second vote from the same voter. A counted vote goes into the ballot map, so the voter can see their own choice later.

name: cleanOption
explanation: Cleans one option label using the option length limit.

name: cleanOptions
explanation: Checks that the options are a list of two to ten valid option labels, and returns them cleaned. Two labels that match without regard to case or outer spaces are refused.

name: cleanSubmissionId
explanation: Returns null when no submission id is given, or the id itself when it is 8 to 100 letters, digits, dashes, or underscores. Any other value is a validation error.

name: cleanText
explanation: Trims a text value and rejects it when it is missing, empty, not text, or longer than the limit.

name: copyTally
explanation: Copies one option tally so that callers cannot change the stored poll.

name: createPoll
explanation: Checks the question, options, and optional submission id, adds a new poll with zero votes and an empty ballot map to the list, and returns it. It throws a validation error when the input is not usable; the submission id is kept on the stored poll so a repeat send of the same form can be found.

name: findPoll
explanation: Returns the poll with the given id from the list, or null when no poll has that id.

name: findSubmission
explanation: Returns the poll that was created with the given submission id, or null when the id is not text or no poll has it.

name: invalid
explanation: Builds a validation error with the given message and the name ValidationError, so the server can answer with a 400 response.

name: listPolls
explanation: Returns every poll in a form safe to send to the browser, without voter ids, with the newest poll first. Each poll says which option the given voter chose, or null when that voter has not chosen one or no voter is given.

name: loadPolls
explanation: Reads the poll list from the JSON data file. A missing file counts as an empty list, and a file that does not hold a list is an error. Each poll is brought up to the current ballot format on the way in.

name: lowerLabel
explanation: Makes an option label ready for the repeat check. Each run of spaces or tabs becomes one space, and letters become lowercase, so labels that read the same compare equal.

name: publicPoll
explanation: Copies one poll into the public shape: id, question, option tallies, total votes, the choice of the given voter, and the creation time. The choice is null when no voter is given.

name: savePolls
explanation: Writes the poll list to the data file. It writes a temporary file first and then renames it, so a crash cannot leave a half-written file.

name: startTally
explanation: Turns one option label into a tally with zero votes.

name: upgradeBallots
explanation: Gives a poll saved with the old voter list a ballot map. Each old voter gets an entry with a null choice, because the old format did not record which option they picked. A poll that already has a ballot map is returned unchanged.

name: viewFor
explanation: Shapes one poll for the voter who asked for the list. listPolls applies it to every poll in the list.
